data.long_meaning: Ansul is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ansu', meaning 'drop'. The name signifies the grace of God, as if bestowed upon an individual like a divine drop of nectar. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
